name: OpenCart Self-Hosted
description: OpenCart is an open-source ecommerce platform for customer-operated online stores. It supports catalogs, inventory, pricing, storefronts, carts, checkout, orders, customers, extensions, and administration.
agentUseSummary: OpenCart Self-Hosted cannot currently be connected to Relay agents because OpenCart 4.1's supported core API exposes only order and subscription workflows, with no isolated read-only catalog, inventory, customer, or order resource contract suitable for a safe V1 connector.

blocked.label: Connect the OpenCart core API
blocked.description: OpenCart's supported core API authentication is bound to its order and subscription workflow endpoints; Relay will not collect an API key when no isolated safe read action can be offered.

blocked.label: Run order or subscription workflows
blocked.description: The core API can construct carts, confirm or edit orders and subscriptions, and append histories. These commerce mutations are too consequential to substitute for a bounded read-only V1.

blocked.label: Use an extension or private endpoint
blocked.description: Relay will not assume a third-party REST extension, scrape storefront or admin HTML, automate a browser, query the database, or reverse engineer undocumented endpoints.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled until OpenCart publishes a supported isolated read-only resource API or Relay separately approves a named extension contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No safe supported read-only OpenCart core API or remote MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No safe supported read-only OpenCart core API or remote MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: OpenCart 4.1's startup API allowlist admits only api/order and api/subscription. Their documented core controller calls construct carts, select customers and addresses, confirm or edit orders and subscriptions, and append histories; the core distribution does not expose an isolated read-only catalog, inventory, customer, or order resource API for a least-privilege Relay connector.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not show Connect or request an OpenCart username, API key, or IP allowlist entry. Reconsider only if OpenCart publishes a supported read-only resource API, or if a separately reviewed named extension with a stable contract and least-privilege read permissions is explicitly commissioned.

evidence.supports: OpenCart's official administration documentation identifies API users as a system setting rather than documenting a general read-only commerce resource API.

The official OpenCart 4.1.0.3 source allowlists only api/order and api/subscription, requires an API username, source-IP allowlist, timestamp, and HMAC signature, and blocks direct access to other api routes.

The official order controller exposes cart construction, customer and address selection, shipping and payment selection, order confirmation or editing, and order-history mutation rather than an isolated resource read.
The official subscription controller likewise constructs checkout state, confirms or edits subscriptions, and appends history; it does not provide a safe standalone read-only account surface.
